Commentary.Commentary: Right then, two down, and one more to go. It has been a topsy-turvy tour so far with Australia winning the T20I series 2-1 and then Sri Lanka making a strong comeback to clinch the ODI series 3-2. But now it's time for the ultimate test as the two sides gear up for a two-match Test series starting on the 29th of June. The first Test will be played in Galle and play will begin at 10 am IST (4.30 am GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Till then, take care and goodbye!

Dasun Shanaka then goes on to pick up the series trophy and his team members join him on the podium to celebrate. As the trophy is lifted, the crowd can be heard chanting 'Sri Lanka, Sri Lanka,' quite vociferously.

Dasun Shanaka, captain of Sri Lanka says, that it is disappointing to have lost the match but they need to keep pushing themselves and the crowd has been brilliant. Adds that they took the momentum from the last T20I game into the ODI series and almost won the first ODI but were able to get on a roll after that. Mentions that he is happy with the efforts of his players, especially Kusal Mendis and is happy to see him back in form and then goes on to thank a few more players for their efforts. Adds that the crowd deserves a lot of applause because they always believed in the team and then goes on to applaud the Australian team, the staff, and also the groundsmen.

The Australian skipper, Aaron Finch is down for a quick chat. He says that the series was hard-fought, but he credits Sri Lanka for the way they played and adds that Sri Lanka deserved to win. Mentions that most of their players got the starts but they were not able to put big partnerships. They did get partnerships of 40 and 50 runs but they are not enough. Further adds that going forward they need to maximize the middle overs. But he is pleased with how the team performed in this final ODI. Concludes by thanking all the fans, and says they have been amazing.

Kusal Mendis (249 runs in 5 matches) is the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for scoring the most runs in the series! He says that he is happy to have performed for the team and is happy that they were able to win the series. Adds that it is an important series victory especially given the World Cup coming up next year. Ends by saying that his role in the team is quite clear.

Chamika Karunaratne (75 runs off 75 balls) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his valiant effort even though he ended on the losing side. This is something we don't see that often in cricket but such was the importance of his innings in this game. Karunaratne joins Roshan Abeysinghe for a chat. He says that he is very happy after this knock only because he has not been performing with the bat but he always believed in himself and he knew today was his day. Adds that he wanted to only rotate the strike, and keep batting till the end, they wanted to get 200 on board and he further adds that Pramod Madushan supported him really well from the other end. Concludes by thanking all the fans for their support and also thanking the Australian team to tour Sri Lanka in such difficult times.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, after opting to bat first, Sri Lanka were never ever allowed to get off the blocks and the Australian bowlers just kept on picking wickets at regular intervals. Josh Hazlewood was brilliant at the top of the order as usual and Matthew Kuhnemann too bowled really well. With Sri Lanka on course of being bundled out for less than 100, Chamika Karunaratne took on the mantle and put on a brilliant display with the bat to score 75 runs and he was well-supported by debutant Pramod Madushan. The hosts did get past 150 but with the depth, Australia have in their batting lineup, they were able to get rid of early batting woes to go on and win the match.

Sri Lanka had a modest total on the board but were able to make a match out of it and at one point, they were even in control of the game. After starting with pace, Dasun Shanaka brought in spinners from both ends, and Maheesh Theekshana along with Dunith Wellalage bowled in tandem and never let the Aussies have an easy time. In the middle overs though, the other spinners weren't just able to pick up wickets even though the required rate was kept in check. Dunith Wellalage came back in to pick up two more wickets but in the end, Sri Lanka just didn't have enough runs on the board and were handed a comprehensive defeat.

Australia needed just 161 runs to win, a brilliant opportunity for them to end a disappointing ODI series on a high. The job however became all the more difficult when both openers fell inside the first three overs. After that, it kept on getting worse and at one point they were 50/4. Then came a match-saving partnership worth 51 runs between Marnus Labuschagne and Alex Carey which got the visitors a bit ahead in the game. A couple of more wickets fell but Carey stayed at the crease and had brilliant support from Cameron Green at the other end. The pair made sure that they saw their side over the line safely.

It has been a hard-fought contest but it is Australia who have shown grit and determination to get over the line, thanks to a brilliant match-winning knock from Alex Carey. The five-match ODI series ends 3-2 in favor of Sri Lanka. Also, there is a huge chant of Australia from the crowd, showing their gratitude to the touring side. Aaron Finch is seen leading the response as he and his men take a round of the stadium soaking in the applause from the crowd in the R. Premadasa.
SIX! Bang! Cameron Green finishes things off in style! Fuller ball, around the off pole. Cameron Green dances down the track and tonks it long off for a biggie. Australia win by 4 wickets!
Very full, on the pads, tosses it up. Cameron Green flicks it towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Alex Carey sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Outside off, fuller in length. Cameron Green steps down the track and blocks it out.
Pitched up, outside off, that one stays low as well. Cameron Green stays on the back foot and tries to block this but he misses it completely.
Tossed up delivery, very full on this occasion. Cameron Green pushes it on the right of the bowler. Maheesh Theekshana dives to his right and makes a terrific stop.
Fuller ball, around middle. Alex Carey once again plays the reverse-sweep past point for a single this time.
Around middle, full in length. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps this one but to the fielder at point.

NOT OUT! A peach of a delivery! Tosses this one up, full in length, the ball lands around off, grips and spins away outside off. Alex Carey leans to drive this but he misses. Kusal Mendis grabs the ball and whips the bails off. The umpires check for the stumping here and the replay shows that Alex Carey's back foot was well inside.

Is that stumped? Alex Carey seems to have raised his foot for a split second but did the bails come off at that time? It is sent upstairs and the third umpire is first checking UltraEdge. There's a flat line as the ball passes the bat. The side-on angle is then checked and Carey's back leg is grounded when the bails are taken off. NOT OUT is the decision on the big screen.
FOUR! Full and outside off. Cameron Green presses forward and slices it aerially over point for a boundary. Australia are 5 runs away now!
Beaten! This one lands around middle, and spins away. Cameron Green stays on the back foot and tries to block this but he gets beaten.
Tosses this one up, fuller in length, around middle. Alex Carey gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps this towards deep cover for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, shorter ball. Alex Carey misses his flick. Wide called!
Outside off, fuller ball. Alex Carey plays the reverse-sweeps but onto the deck.
Down the leg side, fullish ball. Alex Carey pushes it towards short fine leg. A little fumble there by the fielder allows the batters to take a couple of runs.
Tosses this one up, full, around middle. Cameron Green gets down on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Fuller now, around middle, tossed up as well. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps this towards the fielder at point. 14 needed off 78 balls.
Good running! A shorter ball, around middle and leg. Alex Carey pushes it off the back foot wide of long on for a brace.
Loopy ball, slower through the air, full and on the pads. Alex Carey leans and flicks it towards short fine leg.
Very full this time, around middle. Cameron Green knocks it down to long off and rotates the strike.
Tosses this up now, around middle, full in length. Alex Carey sweeps it towards deep square leg for single.
FOUR! Good start to the over for Australia! A googly, short in length, outside off. Alex Carey punches this off the back foot through cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Top shot! Shorter one, outside off. Cameron Green uses the depth of the crease and smashes it straight down the ground for a boundary. Australia need 22 runs off 84 balls.
Shorter, around middle. Cameron Green stays on the back foot and defends it out.
Slower this time, loopy one as well, around off. Cameron Green steps down and pushes it back to the bowler.
Quicker, spinning into the right-hander, around middle and leg. Cameron Green blocks it out.
On the pads now, full in length, Alex Carey works it away towards square leg for a single.
Fuller ball, this one lands around off, grips and spins away. Alex Carey prods forward and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Charith Asalanka is back on!
Quicker one, fired into middle and leg, Green flicks it towards mid-wicket. 27 needed now off 90 balls.
A variation from Maheesh Theekshana this time, seemed to be bowled from the back of the hand. On middle, Green keeps it out.

Free runs here for Australia and they will certainly take it. Full and around off, Green pushes it back towards the bowler. Maheesh Theekshana however tries to get cheeky and throws it back towards the stumps but misses and the keeper misses the ball as well. The ball eventually runs down to the fence.
A touch shorter, on off. Green punches it off the back foot and past the diving fielder at mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good running.
An appeal from the bowler but certainly the impact seems well outside off. This is flighted, well outside off. Cameron Green strides forward looking to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads.
On middle, Carey works it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Around leg stump, this is turned past square leg for an easy single. 34 needed now off 96 balls.
Carey tries to use his feet but can't get it through. Gives it a lot more air and bowls it on off, Carey steps out and drives it straight towards mid off.
Around off, Green gets a big stride across the stumps and manages to paddle it down to fine leg for just one more.
Wellalage drags back the length and bowls it around middle. Alex Carey brings out the reverse sweep and plays it towards deep backward square leg for a run.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Cameron Green stands tall and drives it towards sweeper cover for one.
Floats it up, on off. This is punched straight to the man at short cover.
Quicker and turning into middle and leg, Green eases it past square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, Green keeps this one out.
Goes the other way now! Flatter and outside off, going away from the right-hander. Green plays inside the line of the ball.

Cameron Green is a lucky guy! Nicely flighted, on off and turning in sharply, Green steps out looking to get to the pitch of the ball but is beaten in flight. The ball takes the inside edge and rolls off the pads towards first slip as Green scampers back.
On a shorter length, turning in from outside off. Cameron Green gets behind the line of the ball to make the block.
Full and on the pads, this is flicked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Cameron Green comes to the crease.

OUT! KNOCKED HIM OVER! Dunith Wellalage has the last laugh and might have just given his side a huge opportunity to win the game. This is drifted in beautifully onto middle and leg and on a nagging length. Glenn Maxwell is pushed back as the ball grips and turns away. Maxwell is completely squared up and the ball goes on to crash into the off stump. Wellalage gets his third wicket. Australia now need 40 runs off 108 deliveries.

A big, big appeal from the bowler but it is not given. Length, around off, Maxwell looks to block it off the front foot but seems to have missed it. The replay though shows that Maxwell did get an inside edge onto the pads.
Very full and around middle, Maxwell works it past the man at mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Quicker and flatter, outside off. Glenn Maxwell rocks back to cut and does so past the man at short third man for a boundary. 42 needed now off 111 balls.
Slower through the air and drifted onto middle and leg, Maxwell just eases it towards cover.
Full and around off, Alex Carey gets a big stride forward and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for one.
Quicker one, on off. Maxwell blocks it out.
FOUR! A boundary after 94 balls and that will ease the nerves for Glenn Maxwell. This is floated up around off, Maxwell goes inside-out over extra cover to find the fence.
Around middle and leg and it is the wrong 'un, sliding onto the pads. Maxwell doesn't read it and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, full and outside off, Glenn Maxwell caresses it through the cover region for a couple of runs.
On off, this is driven towards extra cover.
Flatter delivery, on a length and on off. Maxwell goes on the back foot to nudge it towards backward point.
Touch short again, outside off. Glenn Maxwell knocks it off the back foot toward cover-point for a single. Australia need 53 runs off 120 balls now.
A low full toss, on the pads. Glenn Maxwell works it away towards square leg for a brace.
Flighted delivery, fuller one, around middle. Glenn Maxwell pushes this back to the bowler.
Shorter now, wide of off. Glenn Maxwell pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Loopy ball, full, around off. Glenn Maxwell blocks it out.
Tosses this up, full, around middle. Alex Carey sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full, around middle. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps this past point for a single.
Tad shorter, around middle. Alex Carey flicks to square leg off the back foot.
Outside off, fuller ball. Alex Carey takes a big stride forward and defends it out.
Tosses it up, full, on middle. Alex Carey pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter one now, spinning in around middle. Glenn Maxwell flicks it past mid-wicket for a single. He gets off the mark straightaway.
Fuller ball, around off. Alex Carey pushes it towards cover for a single.
Glenn Maxwell walks in at number 7.

OUT! LBW! Dunith Wellalage comes into the attack and strikes straightaway! Much-needed wicket this for Sri Lanka. A fuller ball, this one lands around middle and spins away. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and tries to block this but he misses and gets hit on his back pad. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger. Marnus Labuschagne opts for a review immediately. No bat involved there! Ball tracking indicated three reds! This game is still alive! Marnus Labuschagne walks back.
Quicker, spinning away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne dabs it towards point.
Very full, tosses this one up, around middle. Alex Carey flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Another full ball, outside off. Alex Carey tries to sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his arm.
Outside off, fuller ball. Alex Carey leans forward and tries to block this but he misses and gets hit on his pads.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side. Alex Carey leaves it alone. Wide called! 100 up for Australia! Also, that brings up the 50 partnership between these two! Australia are 61 runs away now.
Short in length, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Dunith Wellalage (5-0-15-1) is back on.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Marnus Labuschagne drives it down to long off for a single.
Shorter in length, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne nudges it towards square leg.
Another tossed up ball, full, around off. Marnus Labuschagne leans and blocks it towards point.
Beaten! Loopy ball, full, spinning away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leans forward and gets beaten on his defense.
Fuller now, around middle and leg. Alex Carey clips it towards deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Spinning in, around middle, shorter ball. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Drops it short, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Pulls his length back a tad now, outside off, at 125 clicks. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
Pitched up, outside off, slower in pace, at around 115 clicks. Alex Carey drives it towards cover-point and takes a single.
Another length delivery, around off. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and tries to block this but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg. Single taken!
Fuller now, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne drives it down the ground. Chamika Karunaratne dives to his right and makes a good stop.
On a length, outside off, at 135 clicks. Marnus Labuschagne guides it down to third man for a brace.

Uppish but safe! Nicely flighted, around off and turning away. Labuschagne looks to drive but ends up chipping it to the right of the man ta short cover. The fielder over there went the wrong way and couldn't adjust quickly enough. Just the single then. 71 needed now off 25 overs.
Flatter delivery, on a nagging length and the ball just skids on. Marnus Labuschagne does well to get on the back foot and keep it out on the off side.
Misfield! Around leg stump, Alex Carey goes for the reverse sweep bit mistimes it towards short third man where Dunith Wellalage fumbles and allows the single.
On a shorter length and around leg, this is worked away towards short fine leg.
Floats it up full and on the pads, Carey nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Nice tossed up on off stump, Alex Carey pushes it back towards the bowler.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes back to bowl.
Short of a length and outside off, Labuschagne with a short-arm jab straight towards the man at mid-wicket.
Back of a length, around off, this is guided away fine towards third man for one.
Comes from around the wicket to the left-hander and angles in a length ball around the top of off. Carey hangs back and edges it towards silly point.
Short of a good length, angled at the body. Labuschagne tucks it away 'round the corner and collects a single.
Really well-directed! A 134-kph short ball from Charith Asalanka, on off and just shooting up off the surface. Labuschagne gets hurried on as he looks to pull and misses the shot.
Fuller and outside off, stylishly driven towards deep point for a single by Alex Carey.
Looks like Marnus Labuschagne is struggling with something out there in the middle. The physio is out there to check on him.
WIDE! An attempted slower bumper, spilled well outside off. Wide called.
Chamika Karunaratne is back on! He went for 10 runs in his first over!
Down the leg side, Marnus Labuschagne gets down to sweep but gets a bottom edge on it. The ball goes fine but it is cut off and Labuschagne will pick up a couple of runs.
Fuller and on off, this is driven through mid off for a single.
On middle, blocked out by Carey.
Nicely bowled! Drifted into off and draws the drive from the batter. The ball then grips and turns away, beating Alex Carey comprehensively.
Floats it up, around middle. Alex Carey goes inside-out and drives it past extra cover for a couple of runs.
Charith Asalanka comes from 'round the wicket and drifts it onto middle and leg. Alex Carey defends it off the back foot.
Quicker one, on off. Marnus Labuschagne defends it from inside his crease.
Flighted this time, around middle and leg and turning in. Labuschagne works it towards square leg.

An unconvincing appeal from the Lankans but it is turned down. Around leg stump, Labuschagne looks to flick it away but misses. The ball loops up off the pads and is safely pouched by the man at leg slip.
WIDE! Length again, turning in a long way from around off and ending up past the leg stump. Wided.
On a length, outside off. Labuschagne goes on the front foot to defend it out.
Tight run but it is well-judged in the end. Shorter and quicker, turning away from the off pole. Carey taps it towards short fine leg and Labuschagne calls him for the single.
Floats this one up down the leg side, Carey nudges it away towards short leg.
Around off, driven past point for one more. 84 needed now off 29 overs.
Tosses it up, on off, Marnus Labuschagne pushes it down to long on and collects a single.
Looped up, on off stump, Labuschagne presses forward and plays it with soft hands towards mid on.
Flatter delivery, angled into off stump. Alex Carey rocks back and cuts it off the stumps towards cover-point for an easy single.
On the pads, this is nudged away past square leg for a single by Labuschagne.
Fuller and on leg stump, Labuschagne blocks it out.
WIDE! Drifted down the leg side and turning further down, wide called.
Touch shorter, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it offf the back foot towards square leg for a single.
Flatter, quicker, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and tries to block this one but he misses.
Tosses it up, fuller one, around middle. Alex Carey attempts a reverse-sweep but the ball goes off the inside edge back onto his pads and towards square leg. Another run taken.
Touch shorter now, around off. Marnus Labuschagne shuffles across and nudges it towards square leg. Single taken!
Fuller now, outside off. Alex Carey drives it towards point and scampers across the other end. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses.
Pitches it around middle and leg, spinning away. Alex Carey looks to flick this one but he misses.
Maheesh Theekshana (5-1-10-2) is brought back into the attack.
Tad shorter now, around middle and leg. Alex Carey flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike!
Full, loopy one, outside off. Alex Carey prods forward and defends it out.
Another tossed-up delivery, outside off, full in length. Alex Carey lunges and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Alex Carey presses forward and defends it out.
Drifiting in, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne works it away through square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, full, around the leg pole. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps this past cover-point for a single.
Time for some more spin as Charith Asalanka is brought into the attack.
Sharp turn once again! This one lands around middle, and spins away outside off. Marnus Labuschagne once again gets beaten while trying to defend that one.
Beaten! Shorter in length, spinning away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne stays in his crease and tries to block this but he misses.
On the pads, turning in, shortish ball. Alex Carey flicks it towards deep square leg. Single taken!
Tad shorter, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne looks to push this away but he gets an inside edge towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Alex Carey flicks it towards mid on and rotates the strike.
Slower through the air, full, a leg-break, down the leg side. Alex Carey looks to reverse-sweep this one but he misses.
Pitched up again, around off. Alex Carey drives towards mid off and takes a quick single.
Angling in now, on the pads, fuller ball. Alex Carey flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. Exactly 100 runs are needed now for Australia to win.
Change of angle now! Pramod Madushan goes 'round the wicket, serves a full ball, outside off, slower in pace as well. Alex Carey leans to drive but he misses.
Back of a length, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne drags it from the inner half of his bat past mid-wicket for a single.
Well bowled! Full again, outside off, shaping away a tad. Marnus Labuschagne looks to drive this but he misses as the ball zips past his outside edge.
Pitched up, around middle and off, at 131 clicks. Marnus Labuschagne drives and finds the fielder at mid off.
Drifting in this time, shorter ball, around middle and leg. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike!
A JAFFA! Beaten this time! Slower through the air, this one lands around off and spins away. Marnus Labuschagne lunges forward and looks to defend this but he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Slower through the air, full, around off. Alex Carey reverse-sweeps this past point for a single.
Loopy one, full, around off. Alex Carey lunges forward and defends it out.
Tosses it up again, full, around middle. Alex Carey sweeps it behind square on the leg side and takes a couple of runs.
An appeal for LBW, but turned down! A loopy ball, full, around middle and leg. Alex Carey looks to reverse-sweep this one but he misses and gets hit on his pads.

FOUR! Just a bit too straight from Pramod Madushan this time and that's easy pickings for Marnus Labuschagne. Length, sliding down leg, Labuschagne just tickles it fine and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence.

DRINKS! Sri Lanka have made perfect use of the conditions. The spinners are getting the ball to talk and they have put Australia under immense pressure. The visitors need a partnership here. This game is very much alive at the moment!

OUT! CAUGHT! Mitchell Marsh ends up giving his wicket away and the debutant, Pramod Madushan has his very first wicket in ODI cricket! After bowling tight line and lengths, Madushan pushes this one full and wide and there's some away movement on offer. Marsh goes after it and goes a bit too hard at it, ends up slciing it high and towards the backward point fence. Pathum Nissanka runs to his left from the point fence and takes a safe catch. Just when Australia looked to crawling back into the game, the set-batter is dismissed.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Pramod Madushan

Commentary.Commentary: Length again, on off, Marsh plays a checked drive towards mid off.
Length, around the top of off. Marsh pushes it towards mid off.
Good length, close to the off pole. Mitchell Marsh looks to punch it off the back foot but gets a bottom edge back onto the deck.
Short of a length, on the body. Labuschagne works it off the back foot towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 50 is up for Australia.
A touch shorter, around off and turning away. Mitchell Marsh looks to come forward and drive but checks his shot and plays inside the line of the ball.
Short and wide, thrashed away off the back foot by Marsh towards deep cover. Maheesh Theekshana slips but manages to get a hand on it over there but Marsh does pick up two more.
Good running, an early call for two and gets there with ease. Flatter this time, its the googly, Mitchell Marsh works it through square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
On a length this time, turning away from around off. Marsh taps it towards cover-point.
Full again and drifted onto middle, Marsh backs away to drive it towards cover.
Floated up, very full and on off. Marsh punches it out towards extra cover.
Short of a length, outside off. Labuschagne plays it off the back foot but straight to the man at short cover.
This is angled into middle and leg, Labuschagne stays solid in defense.

EDGED AND FOUR! On a shorter length this time, outside off and shaping away. Marnus Labuschagne throws his hands at it and gets a thick outside edge that flies past the man at second slip and into the vacant third man fence.
Around the top of off, around 135 clicks. Labuschagne solidly blocks it out.
Nice shape again from the debutant. On a perfect length, angling in from outside off and then moving away. Marnus Labuschagne gets all squared up and beaten past the outside edge yet again.
Starts off with a length ball, around off and nipping away a touch. Marnus Labuschagne looks to just steer it fine but is beaten past the outside edge.
Pramod Madushan the debutant, comes into the attack.
Fuller in length and on middle, Marsh plays it with soft hands towards backward square leg. 120 needed now to win off 38 overs.
On off again and this is tapped towards cover-point.
On a nagging length and around off. Marsh looks to go forward but has to go back inside his crease to keep it out.
Short again, outside off. Marsh hits it hard off the back foot towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! That will break the shackles a bit. Dragged down around off, Mitchell Marsh rocks back and pulls it hard in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Lovely delivery to start off with. Gives it a good rip and flights it on off stump, the ball grips and turns away sharply beating the outside edge of Marsh's willow.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes into the attack.
Floated up, outside off, Marsh drives it with good timing but towards the fielder on the cover fence for just a single.
A bit more round-arm from Dunith Wellalage and the ball turns away from the off pole. Marsh keeps it out on the off side.
Looped up, around off. Marsh defends it off the front foot.

This is angled into the pads and seems to be going on with the arm. Mitchell Marsh looks to block but misses and gets hit on the front pad. Huge appeal for an LBW decision...it is turned down! Dasun Shanaka does go for the review this time. The third umpire checks the UltraEdge first. There is a clear gap between bat and pad and the umpire moves on to Ball Tracking which shows that everything is fine except the ball is sliding down the leg side. Review lost and Sri Lanka have no more reviews which could a huge loss for them. NOT OUT!
Quicker and flatter, on middle. Mitchell Marsh keeps it out.
Beauty! Nicely drifted into off stump, Marsh is drawn forward to make the block but the ball turns away and beats the outside edge by an inch.
End of Powerplay 1! The fielding side can now have as many as 4 four fielders outside the inner ring till the end of the 40th over.
Outside off, loopy ball, full in length. Marnus Labuschagne prods forward and defends this one out.

Pitched up, around middle and leg, turning in. Marnus Labuschagne leans to block this but he misses and the ball lobs up towards leg slip after hitting the pads. A stifled appeal there but turned down.
Swing and a miss! Tosses it up, full, this one lands outside off, and spins in sharply. Marnus Labuschagne leans to drive this but he gets beaten on the inside edge.
Around middle, shorter ball. Marnus Labuschagne blocks it out.
Spinning in around middle. Mitchell Marsh flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Wide! Down the leg side. Mitchell Marsh leaves it alone. Wide called!
Pitched up, spins in, around middle. Mitchell Marsh stays in his crease and defends it out.
Shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leaves it alone.
This one comes in with the arm, quicker, shorter, around middle. Mitchell Marsh stays back and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Beaten! Full, loopy ball, spinning away, outside off. Mitchell Marsh presses forward and gets beaten on the outside edge.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Fuller ball, tosses this one up, spinning away. Mitchell Marsh drives it towards the fielder at cover, who slides to stop the ball, but it goes through himIt races away towards the topes for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, full, around off. Marnus Labuschagne drives it towards cover and rotates the strike.
Sharp turn again! Shorter ball, spins in, around middle and leg. Mitchell Marsh stays back and misses his flick.
Slower through the air very full, around middle. Mitchell Marsh flicks it to the fielder at mid on.
Tosses it up, spins in, down leg. Mitchell Marsh looks to reverse-sweep this again but he misses it.
On middle, loopy ball. Mitchell Marsh blocks it out.
Tosses this one up, spinning in sharply, around middle. Mitchell Marsh gets an inside edge towards square leg.
FOUR! That should release some pressure! A fuller ball, around off. Mitchell Marsh gets down on his knee and reverse-sweep this one past short third man for a boundary.
Turn again! Loopy ball, this one lands around off, spins away sharply. Marnus Labuschagne gets beaten while trying to defend this one.
On the pads now, full again. Mitchell Marsh flicks it towards square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, outside off. Mitchell Marsh lunges forward and defends it out.
Shorter ball, around off. Mitchell Marsh uses the depth of his crease and defends it out.
Beaten now! Outside off, spinning away, full. Mitchell Marsh prods and misses his defense.
Spinning away, full, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne leans and drives it through cover for a single.
Tosses it up, turning in again, around the pads. Mitchell Marsh looks to flick this but he misses and gets hit on his pads again.
Very full, around middle. Marnus Labuschagne works it away towards long on for a single.
Quicker, flatter, on the pads. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it towards short fine leg.
Turn again! Fuller, spinning in, around off. Marnus Labuschagne leans to block this but he misses as the ball spins in and hits him on his pads. A stifled appeal there for LBW, but not given!
Marnus Labuschagne is in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maheesh Theekshana, you beauty! He gets his second wicket and Australia have lost their third. A fuller one again, turning in, on the pads. Josh Inglis prods forward and looks to glance this away. But the ball goes off his inside edge, onto his pads, and lobs u towards leg slip. Pathum Nissanka there takes an easy catch. Australia in trouble early on!
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: A ripper! What a lovely delivery! A fuller ball, spinning in sharply, around middle. Josh Inglis presses forward and tries to block this but he misses and gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball flies juts over the stumps as well.
Flatter delivery, on off. Marsh keeps it out.
This time, Josh Inglis is able to maneuver the ball past the man at short cover. On off, driven down to long off for a single.
On off, Inglis can't get it past the man at short cover.
Around off, Inglis steps out and pushes it towards cover.

Huge appeal for LBW from the bowler but Inglis is a bit too down the track for the umpire to give that out. On a length and on off, Inglis looks to use his feet but has to check his shot. Inglis misses the block and gets hit on the pads. The replay shows that if Sri Lanka had reviewed it, it would have been curtains for Josh Inglis, twice inside 5 overs that they have not taken the review whcih would have gone in their favour.
Full and outside off, turning away. Josh Inglis pushes it out towards cover off the back foot.
A touch fuller and down leg, Marsh tickles it down to short fine leg. Maiden!
Flatter delivery, sliding onto the pads, tucked away behind square on the leg side.
Here comes the natural variation from Maheesh Theekshana. On middle and leg and this one just goes straight on, Marsh nudges it on the leg side.

Huge turn again! On a fullish length and outside off, Mitchell Marsh looks to punch it off the back foot but misses and pinged on the pads. Sri Lanka think about the review but the impact seems to be outside the line of the off stump.
Slight halt! Mitchell Marsh has been struck on his helmet while trying to attempt a reverse sweep. The physio is out there to conduct the mandatory concussion test.

Mitchell Marsh looking to try something different in order to get a move along here. Full and straight, Marsh attempts the reverse sweep but the ball goes off the toe end and onto the helmet. The physio is out in order to do a mandatory concussion check.
On a nagging length, skidding through from around off. Marsh keeps it out off the back foot.
FOUR! Sweetly timed to get off the mark on ODI debut from Josh Inglis. This is dragged down outside off, Inglis rocks back and slaps it through the cover region to find the fence.
A touch quicker, outside off and turning away. Inglis has a feel for it but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Full and drifted onto middle and leg, Inglis pushes it out on the off side.
Josh Inglis the debutant walks out to bat.

OUT! TAKEN! An absolute stunner from Danushka Gunathilaka and both the Aussie openers are back in the hut early. This is tossed up on off stump, David Warner uses his feet to negate the turn but doesn't quite get to the pitch of the ball. Warner goes through with the shot and hits it really hard to the left of the man at mid off. Danushka Gunathilaka flies to his left and just pouches it out of thin air. Gunathilaka has hurt himself in the fall but Dunith Wellalage gets a wicket in his first over. Unfortunately, Danushka Gunathilaka is taken off the field as his shoulder seems to be in a world of pain.
Commentary.Howout: c Danushka Gunathilaka b Dunith Wellalage

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off, Marsh plays it off the back foot past backward point for a single.

Almost chopped on! Dunith Wellalage starts off with the arm-ball on middle and leg. Mitchell Marsh backs away looking to cut but the ball slides on and goes off the inside edge, onto the boot and into the keeper's gloves. The ball did hit the ground and hence Marsh is safe.
Seeing the ball turn so much, Dasun Shanaka has opted to bring a spinner from the other end as well. Dunith Wellalage comes into the attack.

Jaffa! Maheesh Theekshana switches to 'round the wicket for the left-hander and floats it up around off. David Warner looks for the expansive drive with the turn but the ball turns sharply and a long way as well, beating the outside edge of Warner's willow.
On a length, turning in from around off. Marsh goes on the back foot and works it towards mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
WIDE! Maheesh Theekshana is turning the ball square here! Around off and turning down the leg side, wide called.
Shorter in length, turning in a long way from outside off. Mitchell Marsh hangs back and manages to fend it away on the leg side.
Mitchell Marsh walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maheesh Theekshana does get his man and draws first blood here. A touch fuller and spinning in from outside off. Aaron Finch gets a big stride forward and looks to sweep but the ball goes off the gloves and then off his shoulders as well, looping up around first slip. Charith Asalanka over there takes a simple catch and Finch starts walking off. Sri Lanka have the early breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Charith Asalanka b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, turning in from outside off. Aaron Finch looks to work it leg side but misses. The ball goes off the pads and loops up towards square leg where it is pouched. Appeal for a catch but it is turned down. Dasun Shanaka has gone upstairs. The third umpire checks the replay and on first glance, the ball seems to be pretty far away from the bat and that is confirmed by the UltraEdge as well. The LBW is also checked. Ball Tracking shows that the ball is going a long way down leg. NOT OUT!

In the air and taken! But the umpire says it's off the pads. Slowed up, on a length and drifting onto the pads. The ball turns a long way and goes off Finch's pads towards backward square leg where the fielder takes a diving catch. The replay shows that no bat is involved.
WIDE! Starts off with a quicker delivery, going down leg, wide called.
Who will bowl from the other end? Maheesh Theekshana it is!
Shorter ball, wide of off. David Warner looks to cut this away, but the ball goes off his under-edge onto the deck and oer the keeper. Two taken! 10 runs off the first over!
A length ball, outside off. David Warner leaves it alone.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short again, width on offer now. David Warner slashes this past extra-cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Australia and David Warner are up and running in fine fashion! Overpitched, around middle. David Warner lifts it over the bowler's head, and down the ground for a boundary.
Back of a length, around middle. David Warner blocks it out solidly.

Chamika Karunaratne begins with a shorter ball, around off. David Warner looks to slash this one but he misses. The replay shows that there was a faint edge on it and it's an opportunity missed for Sri Lanka.
